import numpy as np
im = Image.open('radiograph.jpg').convert('L')
a = np.asarray(im).astype(np.float32)

def top(band_y, name, n=12):
    y0,y1 = int(band_y[0]*H), int(band_y[1]*H)
    sub = res_s[y0:y1]
    idx = np.argsort(sub.ravel())[::-1][:n*200]
    seen=[]

        Y,X = yy+y0, xx
        if all((abs(X-sx)>80 or abs(Y-sy)>80) for sx,sy in seen):
            seen.append((X,Y))
            if len(seen)>=n: break
    print(name)
    for X,Y in seen:
        print(f'  x={X/W:.3f} y={Y/H:.3f} val={res_s[Y,X]:.1f}')
